title: SoundOff: Low-Cost Passive Ultrasound Tags
summary: A research project presenting low-cost passive ultrasound tags designed for non-invasive and non-contact sensing applications. The technology enables battery-free tracking and sensing using ultrasonic waves, making it suitable for IoT and embedded systems deployments.
problem_solved: Provides an affordable, battery-free alternative for wireless sensing and tracking in scenarios where traditional RFID or active sensors are too expensive or impractical.
why_valuable: Enables scalable, low-maintenance sensing solutions for smart environments, healthcare monitoring, and industrial IoT applications without the need for onboard power sources.
